items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: You heard of Sophie? ... So Sophie Tucker came over as soon as she come in, they introduced her, Miss Tucker's in the house. We played 'Some of These Days.' ... she come backstage and go Duke, said Duke, I want you to meet some friends of mine

ctx.x: How was the -- how did it come about that you all decided to go to Europe.
Oh, that's a good question. You know, Sophie Tucker, You heard of Sophie?
